name: Gibraltar law: the Gibraltar Constitution Order 2006 and the Stamp Duties Act 2005 (2005-73)

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactive criminal liability; otherwise a general presumption against retroactivity, not a constitutional bar
default_reach.meaning: the Constitution forbids holding a person guilty of an offence for an act that was not an offence when done, and a penalty severer than the maximum then available; for other law the record states no general rule, and an act that says it applies from an earlier day (several here do) is recorded as such
default_reach.authority: Gibraltar Constitution Order 2006, Annex 1, section 8(4): "No person shall be held to be guilty of a criminal offence on account of any act or omission that did not, at the time it took place, constitute such an offence, and no penalty shall be imposed for a criminal offence that is severer in degree or description than the maximum penalty that might have been imposed for that offence at the time when it was committed."
